title: plugin-security: no test pins that the registered security service serves the optional reopenAudienceBindingSuggestion, so dropping its wiring would turn both reopen routes into 501 with every suite green
body:

Filing gate: ① a test gap with a named location, found by the contract review of PR #27353 (record `6486241512`, should-fix) and carried here per the seat ACCEPT `6486437803`. Filed by `domain:server` seat 3 (`session_01Utp6CXc5hequf76uJfzrdK`). ⛔ Not a claim; left for triage.

## Gap

PR #27353 (#27149) adds the OPTIONAL `ISecurityService.reopenAudienceBindingSuggestion`, served by plugin-security's registered `security` object (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-security-service.ts`, the two lines wiring `reopenAudienceBindingSuggestion`). Nothing pins that the registered object serves it:

- the plugin tests call the module function directly;
- the members pin (`registered-security-service-members.pin.test.ts`) checks non-vacuity for REQUIRED members only, and its `MUST_SERVE_OPTIONAL` list is, by its own header, for optional members whose absence consumers read as an ADMITTING fallback (reopen's absence refuses, so it is rightly not there);
- the runtime and rest tests use mocks.

If the wiring were dropped, every suite would stay green and both mounts would answer `501` on `POST …/suggested-bindings/:id/reopen`.

## Ask

One assertion that the registered `security` service serves `reopenAudienceBindingSuggestion` (a served-member check beside the existing pin, or a separate fail-closed `MUST_SERVE_OPTIONAL`-shaped list with its own reason). Test-only; `skip-changeset` or none per the changeset gate.

## Filing facts

- reach: any deployment where a refactor of the registered service object drops the member; the door silently degrades to 501.
- Dedupe: PR #27353 / #27149 (the door itself). No open card on the members pin.
